cards.title: Card 1: Auth & Sessions
items: Passwords hashed with Argon2id via argon2-cffi; includes startup dummy hash for constant-time rejection (app/core/security.py:L18).
HS256 JWT tokens encode sub, jti, exp; validated against sessions table for immediate revocation on /auth/logout (app/api/deps.py:L24).
Frontend stores token in localStorage ('testpilot_token') and injects Authorization: Bearer header via api client (frontend/src/api/client.js:L9).
Redis rate limiting enforces 10 login attempts per minute per IP (app/core/rate_limit.py:L44).

cards.title: Card 2: Projects & Credentials
items: SSRF firewall in app/core/url_validator.py blocks cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), private IP ranges, and DNS rebinding; permits ALLOWED_PRIVATE_HOSTS (localhost).
Target credentials encrypted at rest with Fernet 128-bit AES-CBC (app/core/security.py:L103); plaintext passwords are never returned over REST APIs.
Plaintext credentials exist in memory ONLY in worker during execute_node; scrubbed from all logs, error fields, and steps (app/agent/executor.py:L20).

cards.title: Card 3: Document Ingestion & Search
items: Upload validates 10MB limit and extensions (.txt, .md, .pdf, .docx, .json) in app/services/document_service.py:L40.
Chunker segments text into ~500-char semantic chunks (app/services/chunker.py:L15).
Dense vectors (384-dim) generated via sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (app/services/embedder.py:L9).
Discrepancy: Model loaded in BOTH API and worker, violating D-018 single-process isolation.
Cosine distance search (<=>) cached in Redis under rag:{project_id}:* with 1-hour TTL.

cards.title: Card 4: Run Lifecycle & State
items: States: QUEUED -> PLANNING -> EXECUTING -> ANALYZING -> REPORTING -> COMPLETED / FAILED / CANCELLED.
Redis duplicate-run lock: run_lock:{project_id} with 900s TTL (HTTP 409 Conflict if active run exists).
Cancellation flag: run_cancel:{run_id} checked at every LangGraph node entry (app/agent/graph.py:L21).
Postgres AsyncThreadPostgresSaver checkpointer persists graph state; unhandled node exceptions transition run to FAILED without crashing the worker.

cards.title: Card 5: Agent Stages & AI vs Code
items: Planner: AI-driven; Google Gemini synthesizes PlannedTestCase list strictly citing requirement IDs (app/agent/planner.py:L56).
Executor: HYBRID; /login is 100% hardcoded script (app/agent/executor.py:L86); post-login steps are LLM-guided; PASS/FAIL decided by LLM observation.
Analyst: AI-driven; executes ONLY on failed test cases; categorizes 5 root-cause classifications and severities (app/agent/analyst.py:L44).
Report: 100% algorithmic Python code; calculates pass rates and aggregations with zero LLM hallucinations (app/agent/report.py:L7).

cards.title: Card 6: LLM Layer & Providers
items: Fallback order: Primary Google AI Studio (GOOGLE_MODEL), fallback Gemini (GOOGLE_FALLBACK_MODEL), tertiary OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_MODEL).
Rate limiter throttles to LLM_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE (default 15 RPM); max retries set to LLM_MAX_RETRIES (app/agent/llm.py:L40).
Estimates ~15 to 25 LLM calls per full 8-test run (1 plan, 1-2 per test execution step, 1 analysis per failure).

cards.title: Card 7: Browser Layer (Playwright MCP)
items: Playwright MCP child process spawned over stdio running @executeautomation/playwright-mcp-server (app/agent/mcp_client.py:L92).
Pinned to version 1.0.12 in mcp/package.json; zero direct playwright imports in backend.
Strict 9-tool allowlist (navigate, click, fill, select, hover, get_visible_text, press_key, screenshot, close).
Full-page PNG screenshots saved to storage/screenshots/{run_id}/{id}.png; served via authenticated endpoint with path traversal guards.

cards.title: Card 8: Guardrails & Budgets
items: MAX_TESTS_PER_RUN: 8 test cases max per execution.
MAX_STEPS_PER_TEST: 15 browser action steps max per test before timeout.
TEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: 120s limit per test case; RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: 900s global limit.
Rate limits: 10 logins/min, 5 run creations/min per project, 15 LLM requests/min.

cards.title: Card 9: Data Stores & Partitioning
items: PostgreSQL (testpilot): Users, sessions, projects, credentials, documents, vector chunks, test runs, test cases, results, failures, checkpointer tables.
Redis (db 0): arq task queue, run locks (run_lock), cancel flags (run_cancel), run status cache (run_status), RAG cache (rag:), rate limit counters.
Local Disk: storage/documents/ for uploaded specs, storage/screenshots/ for execution evidence.

cards.title: Card 10: Known Gaps & Risks
items: Hardcoded login form: Assumes target app has /login with #email and #password fields; breaks on custom login UIs.
Blunt text truncation: Page text sliced to 1000 characters in executor.py:L174, risking missing action elements on long pages.
SupportDesk coupling: Mentions tickets in graph.py:L61 fallback query and analyst.py:L58 prompt.
Memory budget violation: SentenceTransformer loaded in both API and worker processes.
No flaky test retries: Tests failing due to transient DOM latency are immediately failed without a retry.
